page.title: Datasets
page.intro: Admission, content availability and the local cache are shown separately: admitted tasks whose cache was evicted can still be submitted and are restored from the original digest at run time.
page.deleteDatasetConfirm: Delete dataset "{{name}}" and all its versions? It moves to the recycle bin; existing runs are kept, but it can no longer be used to submit or rerun.
page.deleteVersionConfirm: Delete version "{{dataset}} {{ref}}"? It moves to the recycle bin; existing runs are kept, but it can no longer be used to submit or rerun.
page.notListed: This version is not in the dataset list: it was deleted or does not exist. A deleted version can still be viewed, but not used to submit.

source.confirmMoved: Tag "{{tag}}" now points to new content and will be added as a new version; the old version stays and existing runs are not affected.
source.noUpstream: The source lists no versions; add one below by tag, revision or digest.
source.prepareAfter: Run the first preparation right after adding (build or pull the environment and save the originals)
source.existing: This content is already recorded; nothing new was created

add.title: Add dataset
add.intro: Search only reads external descriptions. Adding pins the reference to an exact digest, downloads and checks the task materials, records them, then runs the first preparation if requested. For new versions of an existing dataset, use "Check upstream updates" on its card.

upstream.title: Upstream versions of {{name}}
upstream.intro: Versions are matched to the platform's by content digest. Adding a new version does not affect existing versions or the runs that use them; results are only shown here and not saved.

tasks.title: Version tasks
tasks.revokePrompt: Reason for revoking the admission of {{task}} (accepted runs are not affected)
tasks.digests: Upstream digest <upstream>{{upstream}}</upstream> · local material digest <material>{{material}}</material> · recorded {{time}}
tasks.prepare_one: Prepare {{count}} task for the first time
tasks.prepare_other: Prepare {{count}} tasks for the first time
tasks.evictTitle: Delete the local image; admission and originals are kept

scoring.saved: Scoring rule confirmed; runs submitted from now on use it
scoring.threshold: Pass threshold (leave empty for no pass rate)

detail.resources: Suggested resources: CPU {{cpus}} · memory {{memory}} MB{{storage}} (author's suggestion; how strictly enforced is unknown)
detail.timeouts: Time limits: Agent {{agent}} s · verification {{verifier}} s · build {{build}} s
